title: Zacchaeus
reflectionQuestion: What do you think Zacchaeus felt when Jesus looked up into the tree and called him by name?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Jesus' Miracles). The JOY-side of the 'you are seen' spine -- Lost Sheep comforts the lonely, Zacchaeus DELIGHTS in the overlooked ('Jesus came to YOUR house'). Wrongdoing kept gentle: 'collecting money, took more than he should' -- NO 'tax/cheat/sinner'; lands on the joyful turnaround (gives it back), not the dishonesty. One image: Jesus stopping under the sycamore and looking up. Delight-set batch 6.
